opportunities.name: Plan city weekend trip end-to-end
opportunities.description: For a given city, date range, party size, two activities, cuisine and friend, look up city facts and weather, find a hotel, two activities and a dinner reservation, save a summary note and draft an email to the friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia / timeanddate / booking / viator / co (restaurant booking) / notes / mail
steps: Search Wikipedia for the city and open its article; record population
Search timeanddate for the city and open Weather; record current temperature
On Booking, enter the city as destination, select check-in/check-out dates, set the number of adults, Search, open the chosen hotel; record name and price
On Viator, search '<activity 1> <city>' and open the chosen tour
On Viator, search '<activity 2> <city>' and open the chosen tour
On the restaurant site, search '<city> <cuisine>', pick the check-in date (Next month if needed), set party size, Find a table, open the chosen restaurant
In Notes, add a note: '<City> <dates>: pop <pop>, <temp>, hotel <hotel> <price>, <activity1>, <activity2>, dinner <restaurant> 19:30'
In Mail, compose to <friend email> with subject '<City> weekend <dates>' and a body summarising hotel, activities and dinner

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, 2 adults, Thames boat + Tower of London, Indian (Benares), maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, 3 adults, Guinness Storehouse + Cliffs of Moher, seafood (SOLE Seafood & Grill), 3 people, tom@example.com
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, 2 adults, whisky tasting + Highlands day trip, Scottish (Evergreen Bar & Kitchen), 2 people, priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Search hotel on Booking for city and dates
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for hotels in a given city with given check-in/check-out dates and party size, then open a chosen hotel.
steps: Click 'Enter destination', select all and type the city
Pick the matching city suggestion
Open the date picker and click the check-in and check-out dates
Open travelers/rooms, adjust adults, click Done
Click Search
Open the chosen hotel from the results

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026 → Club Quarters Hotel London City
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, adults changed to 3 → Ashling Hotel Dublin
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, adults changed to 2 → The Haymarket Hotel

opportunities.name: Search and open activity on Viator
opportunities.description: Search Viator for '<activity> <city>' and open the chosen tour listing.
steps: Click 'Search for a place or activity', select all
Type '<activity> <city>'
Select the 'Search for …' suggestion (or press Search)
Open the chosen tour from the results

instances.values: Thames boat London → Westminster to Greenwich Thames Cruise
Tower of London London → Tower of London and Crown Jewels ticket
Guinness Storehouse Dublin → Guinness Storehouse Experience
Cliffs of Moher Dublin → Dublin to Cliffs of Moher day trip
whisky tasting Edinburgh → 90min Underground Whisky Tasting
Highlands day trip Edinburgh → Highlands, Loch Ness and Glencoe Day Trip

opportunities.name: Find dinner restaurant by city, cuisine, date and party size
opportunities.description: On the restaurant-booking site, search '<city> <cuisine>' for a given date and party size and open the chosen restaurant.
steps: Click the Location/Restaurant/Cuisine box, select all, type '<city> <cuisine>'
Open Date selector, click Next month as needed, pick the date
Set Party size selector to N people
Click Find a table / Let's go
Open the chosen restaurant's details

instances.values: London Indian, Fri 13 Nov → Benares
Dublin seafood, Fri 4 Dec, 3 people → SOLE Seafood & Grill
Edinburgh Scottish, Fri 15 Jan, 2 people → Evergreen Bar & Kitchen

opportunities.name: Save trip note and draft email to friend
opportunities.description: Add a templated trip-summary note and compose an email to a friend with subject '<City> weekend <dates>' summarising hotel, activities and dinner.
steps: Click 'New note', type the summary line and press Enter
In Mail, click To and type the friend's email
Type subject '<City> weekend <dates>'
Type body 'Hi <name>, plan: hotel <hotel> (<price>), <activities>, dinner at <restaurant> (<cuisine>) on <date>.'
Send (recording shows Discard)

instances.values: London Nov 13-15, maya@example.com
Dublin Dec 4-6, tom@example.com
Edinburgh Jan 15-17, priya@example.com

Click the Weather link and read the temperature
